feature_change.scope: Explicit cross-domain a[href] and form[action] destinations only; passive resources, relative targets and body-text URLs are excluded.

real_email_audit.note: Small independent audit; recorded for failure analysis only. Email5 changed from ML-positive to ML-negative after passive-resource exclusion.

known_limitations: external_action_domain_present occurs in 4,405 phishing rows and 0 normal rows.
The model still confuses phishing-warning prose with phishing attempts in email7.
Email6 remains ML-negative; its official-claim external route is shown as a review observation.
Authentication, HTML, antivirus, attachment structure and Razor features had no training variation and therefore have zero coefficients.
Additional labelled real mail is required to estimate real-world false-positive and false-negative rates.
